metadata.sql_query:
SELECT
  p.customer_reference, p.account_id, p.product_code, p.balance_gbp, p.rate_aer,
  c.monthly_income_gbp, c.monthly_outgoings_gbp, c.monthly_surplus_gbp,
  p.position_snapshot_id
FROM thameswell_pb.positions.vw_customer_position p
JOIN thameswell_pb.positions.vw_customer_cashflow_3m c USING (customer_reference)
WHERE p.customer_reference = 'TWBC00418732';
